title: Chris Bledsoe flies a craft down the Cape Fear River

tellings.quote: And he said, "Suddenly the window opened and there was a Capefare River."

plain: In 2007 a man named Chris Bledsoe is said to have found himself flying a craft along the Cape Fear River in North Carolina: "Suddenly the window opened and there was the Cape Fear River," as he put it. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells this on the show, passing on what Bledsoe told him. If true, an ordinary man was taken aboard and even shown the controls of an unknown craft.
